findings.summary: build_features standardizes using the mean/std of the DataFrame it receives, so test-set statistics leak into training (optimistic AUC) and scaling at prediction time depends on the batch, giving the same customer different features across batches.

judge.reason: Describes whole-dataset mean/std leaking test statistics into training, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The standardization division has no guard for zero or NaN std (constant column or single row), producing NaN features that make LogisticRegression raise a ValueError in fit and predict_proba.

judge.reason: Zero-variance/NaN std issue is a known other real problem, not b1.

findings.label: valid_other
